# Immersion Recovery

> > Immersion Recovery is a comprehensive addiction and mental health treatment center in South Florida offering medical detox, residential inpatient care, outpatient programs, and dual diagnosis services through Guardian Recovery's evidence-based approach.

Immersion Recovery operates as part of Guardian Recovery Network Holdings LLC and provides multiple levels of care including medical detoxification, residential treatment, partial hospitalization programs (PHP), intensive outpatient programs (IOP), virtual telehealth services, and sober living support in Delray Beach and surrounding South Florida communities. The facility combines 12-step methodology with medication-assisted treatment (MAT) and clinical therapy for substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health conditions.

## Key Topics

## Core Treatment Programs

- [Addiction & Mental Health Programs | Immersion Recovery](https://www.immersionrecovery.com/addiction-treatment): Main addiction treatment programs: residential, outpatient, medical detox services
- [Medical Detox in Delray Beach, FL | Immersion Recovery](https://www.immersionrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/medical-detoxification): Medically supervised detox with 24/7 clinical monitoring in Delray Beach
- [Residential Addiction Treatment Program | Immersion Recovery](https://www.immersionrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/residential-inpatient): 24/7 residential inpatient addiction treatment with evidence-based therapy
- [Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) for Substance Use Disorder - Guardian Recovery - Immersion Recovery](https://www.immersionrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/partial-hospitalization-program-php): Intensive day treatment program without overnight hospitalization
- [Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) for Addiction Recovery in South Florida - Guardian Recovery - Immersion Recovery](https://www.immersionrecovery.com/addiction-treatment/intensive-outpatient-program-iop): Flexible intensive outpatient program for substance abuse and dual diagnosis
- [Virtual Intensive Outpatient (IOP) Programs in South Florida | Immersion Recovery](https://www.immersionrecovery.com/treatment-process/virtual-intensive-outpatient-program): Telehealth-based intensive outpatient treatment for substance use disorders
